title: Mum's daily calls and feeling like a bad son

assumptions.premise: Being there for your mother requires enduring daily calls that you dread.
assumptions.probe: What does it mean to "be there for her" if each call makes you "dread it"?

assumptions.premise: The emotional toll of these calls is proof that you are failing as a son.
assumptions.probe: What decides whether these calls make someone a "bad son"?

assumptions.premise: Protecting your own limits is equivalent to abandoning her completely.
assumptions.probe: What exists between the feeling that you "can't keep doing this" and that you "can't stop"?
